reports.text: Lake Cachuma Fishing Guide Report 10/18/2026 - Here’s a client of ours that came out with me this morning at beautiful Lake Cachuma, Santa Barbara, CA, to fish for largemouth bass, using a variety of baits. And catch largemouth bass he did, see the picture below.

reports.title: Prosser Reservoir is around half capacity and continues to provide consistent fishing
reports.text: Bass fishing remains fair as fish continue feeding ahead of winter. Anglers targeting bass should focus on weed lines, submerged structure, and warmer pockets of water using crawdad imitations, Senkos, or inline spinners such as Rooster Tails.

reports.title: Water levels at Stampede Reservoir continue to decrease heading into fall
reports.text: Smallmouth bass fishing has slowed considerably with the cooler conditions and, unless the weather changes, the bass bite is expected to remain slow for the remainder of the season.
